legend: Sensible gambling is crucial to ensure that the activity remains enjoyable and does not spiral into harmful behavior. It involves setting limits on time and money spent, understanding the risks, and knowing when to walk away. By practicing self-control and being aware of the potential consequences, individuals can avoid the dangers of addiction and financial strain. Responsible gambling encourages balance, helping players enjoy the experience without it negatively impacting their lives or well-being.
You have $$$k$$$ amount of money which u are ready to risk for gambling and your goal is to have the most amount of money in the end
You are given an array of n integers which determine the money gained or lost playing the ith game.
Here's the description of the game, you can start playing from any index you want. Note that you can back out at any time
If you are currently playing game $$$i$$$, and this is your $$$j$$$'th game so far; Then the next game that you will be playing is game $$$i + j$$$
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \leq t \leq 500$$$) — the number of testcases
The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \leq n \leq 2*10^5$$$) — the size of the array and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \leq k \leq 10^9$$$) — the initial money you hold
The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$) — the game.
output: For each test, print the maximum amount of money u can hold after playing the most desirable situation

legend.ai: 理性赌博对于确保这项活动保持愉快、避免演变为有害行为至关重要。这包括限制投入的时间和金钱、了解其中的风险，并知道何时收手。通过保持自我控制并意识到潜在后果，人们可以避免成瘾和经济压力带来的危险。负责任的赌博倡导保持平衡，帮助参与者享受这一过程，同时避免对自己的生活或身心健康产生负面影响。
你有 $$$k$$$ 资金愿意用于赌博，你的目标是在最后拥有尽可能多的钱。
给定一个由 n 个整数构成的数组，这些整数表示玩第 i 场游戏时获得或损失的钱数。
以下是游戏描述，你可以从任意下标开始游玩。注意，你可以随时退出。
如果你当前正在进行第 $$$i$$$ 局游戏，并且这是你目前为止进行的第 $$$j$$$ 局游戏，那么你接下来要进行的是第 $$$i + j$$$ 局游戏。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \leq t \leq 500$$$)——测试用例的数量。
第一行包含两个整数：$$$n$$$ ($$$1 \leq n \leq 2*10^5$$$)——数组的大小，以及 $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \leq k \leq 10^9$$$)——你持有的初始金额。
第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$) —— 这就是游戏。

output.ai: 对于每组测试，输出在采取最优策略后你能持有的最大金额。
